task: Extraer menciones de personas y organizaciones nombradas que se presentan como datos del documento; no nombres contenidos exclusivamente en instrucciones, ni proyectos explícitamente negados como organizaciones. No inferir relaciones laborales.
selection: No tuning, no retries, no winner selection. Preserve malformed JSON, refusal, truncation, false positives, omissions and unchanged outputs.
evaluation: Original synthetic fixtures with author judgments, not blind and not a benchmark. Report parsing/schema/lexical anchoring independently; effective entity TP/FP/FN on accepted outputs. Failed outputs become empty predictions. Exact case-sensitive type+text set, quote excluded from identity.
evidenceLimit: Exact source substring and value-inside-quote are lexical anchoring only. They do not prove entity type, truth, instruction/data separation or completeness.
fewShot: Two fixed original examples, names disjoint from measured records; deliberately shared task conventions, not a generalization claim.
toolScope: Fixed local dispatcher tests only. No external tool side effect and no claim that model tool-calling was evaluated.
modelBudget: 24 greedy requests, max192 new tokens each. No measured latency comparison; inference elapsed is diagnostic only.
provenance: Record exact chat messages, token IDs, generated token IDs, raw decoded string and hashes before validation. Never silently strip fences or repair JSON.
